onboarding.welcome_title: 🎉 Welcome to Bank Statement Inspection Tool
onboarding.welcome_message: This is your first time launching the program. We will guide you through how to use this tool to get you started quickly.
onboarding.welcome_features: This tool supports: multi-bank statement auto-recognition, subject matching, incremental merge, balance check, duplicate detection, financial export, and more.
onboarding.step1_desc: Create an Excel file with subject names in column A and bank accounts in column B. Recommended name: 「主体查找表.xlsx」, placed in the same directory as the program.
onboarding.step2_desc: Place bank statement Excel files in the same folder, with filenames starting with the bank name (e.g., 「北京银行_202401.xlsx」).
onboarding.step3_desc: Launch the program, select 「Main Pipeline」 mode, then choose the folder containing the statement files.
onboarding.step4_desc: The program will automatically copy the folder, scan files, identify banks, extract data, match subjects, and generate the summary table.
onboarding.step5_desc: After processing, you can find 「银行流水总表.xlsx」 and various analysis reports in the program directory.
onboarding.steps_note: 💡 Tip: You can always run 「One-click Demo Mode」 to see a complete processing flow example.
onboarding.lookup_intro: The subject lookup table is a mapping between bank accounts and subject names. The program uses this table to match the corresponding subject for each transaction record.
onboarding.col_subject_desc: Company/person name the bank account belongs to, e.g., 「北京XX科技有限公司」.
onboarding.col_account_desc: Specific bank account number, e.g., 「01090312345678901」. The program automatically strips leading zeros for matching.
onboarding.col_priority_desc: When one account maps to multiple subjects, the one with higher priority is used. Higher number = higher priority, default is 0.
onboarding.col_extra_desc: You can add any extra fields like 「Remarks」, 「Tax ID」, etc. These fields will be preserved in the summary table.
onboarding.rule1: Leading zeros are automatically ignored during bank account matching, ensuring 「010900123」 and 「10900123」 match correctly.
onboarding.rule2: When multiple records exist for the same account, the one with the highest priority is used.
onboarding.rule3: Fuzzy matching is supported - when exact match fails, similarity matching is attempted automatically.
onboarding.rule4: Lookup table supports .xlsx and .xls formats, .xlsx is recommended.
onboarding.demo_intro: Demo mode uses sample statement files from the samples directory to run through the complete processing flow, giving you an intuitive understanding of how the program works.
onboarding.demo_include1: Auto-create sample subject lookup table (with Bank of Beijing, Bank of East Asia account mappings)
onboarding.demo_include2: Use real sample statement files from the samples directory
onboarding.demo_include3: Complete execution: copy folder → scan → identify → extract → match → generate summary
onboarding.demo_include4: Display processing statistics and data preview
